name: WCC GF to Discord
author: weconnectcodeplugins

sections.description:
Gravity Form Discord Plugin sends form submissions from Gravity Form plugins to Discord when someone submits a form. Learn more about Gravity Form Discord Plugin at weconnectcode.com. We also offer other connector for Discord Gravity Form Lawmatics Integration.

License

GPLv2 or later

How to Setup

  • Go to “Discord Accounts” tab then add new account.
  • Go to “Discord Integration” tab then create new Integration.
  • Map required Discord fields to gravity form fields.
  • Send your test entry to Discord by submiting gravity form.
  • Go to “Discord Logs” tab and verify, if entry was sent to Discord.

Connect Discord account

Connect any gravity form to Discord account by safe and secure Oauth 2.0.

Map Discord fields

First select any Discord object then Map gravity form fields to Discord object fields. There is No limitation on number of fields. You can map unlimited fields.

Filter gravity form submissions

Either Send all gravity form submissions to Discord or filter gravity form submissions sent to Discord based on user input. For example , send only those entries to Discord which have work email address.

Manually send to Discord

Send gravity form submissions to Discord when someone submits a gravity form. You can manually send gravity form submissions to Discord.

Discord logs

View a detailed log of each gravity form submission whether sent (or not sent) to Discord and easily resend any gravity form submission to Discord.

Send Data As Discord object Notes

Send one to many gravity form fields as Discord object notes when anyone submits a form on your site.

Why we built this plugin

Gravity Form and some other popular gravity forms are good but you can not send gravity form submissions to any crm including Discord. You can send any gravity form submissions from your wordpress site to Discord with this free wordpress Discord plugin.

Premium Version Features.

This plugin has a Premium version which comes with several additional benifits Gravity Form – Discord.

  • Discord Custom fields and Particularly Phone Fields.
  • Discord Notes Field
  • User Agent and IP related Data Of the Entries
  • WCC Entries Pro Version With all the Premium Features.
  • Super Helpful WCC Addons and Free Updates.
  • By Purchasing the Premium Version of the Plugin, You will Get Free Updates
  • Get Pro Support

We have a separate plugin for Discord. Gravity Form Discord
sections.faq:
Where can I get support?

Our team provides free support at https://weconnectcode.com/contact.

How to integrate Discord in gravity form

You can easily integrate Discord in gravity form. Simply install Gravity Form Discord plugin , Connect Discord account and finally map gravity form fields to Discord object(contact) fields.

Gravity Form Discord web to lead

if API access is not enabled for your organization then simply use Discord web to lead. Enter your organization id and map gravity form fields to Discord case or lead fields.

WordPress Discord Integration

  • You can use Gravity Form or any other wordpress forms plugin.
  • Install this free WordPress Discord Integration plugin then Connect your Discord account to wordpress.
  • Create a Discord Integration , select form then map form fields to Discord Object(Lead, account etc) fields.
  • When anyone submits form , it will go to your Discord account.

Discord WordPress Plugin

  • Easily Connect your Discord account to wordpress site with this free wordpress Discord plugin.
  • First Install Gravity Form plugin and create a simple form.
  • Connect Discord account to wordpress.
  • Create a Discord Integration then map gravity form fields to Discord object(contact) fields.
  • All form submissions will automatically go to your Discord account.

External services

This plugin integrates with the Discord platform. When a user submits a form using Gravity Form, their data is sent to Discord via their API.

Details:
Service Name: Discord
Purpose: To capture and manage inquiries submitted via Gravity Form in the Discord CRM for efficient client management and follow-ups.
Data Sent: Form submission data, including (but not limited to) user-provided name, email, phone number, and message content.
Endpoint: Data is sent securely to the Discord API endpoint.

API Endpoints Used:
    Authorization Endpoint: https://app.discord.com/oauth/authorize
    Token Endpoint: https://app.discord.com/oauth/token
    API Base URL: https://app.discord.com/api/v4/

Privacy and Terms:
    <a href="https://www.discord.com/tos/">Discord Terms of Service</a>
    <a href="https://www.discord.com/privacy/">Discord Privacy Policy</a>
